caption: The drawing depicts six objects arranged on a plain background: a sleeveless top or undergarment with lace along the neck and armholes in muted white and gray-blue hues (top left); a bonnet or cap with lace and decorative patterns, predominantly in shades of gray-blue and white, with two pinkish-red ribbon ties hanging down (top center); a short skirt or petticoat with lace trim at the hem and waistband in white and gray tones (top right); a single heeled shoe in ivory with a strap detail and a small decorative accent, featuring brown and black on the heel and sole (center); a long-sleeved dress or smock, semi-transparent with a lightly ruffled hem and cuffs, predominantly white with gray shadowing (bottom left); and another long-sleeved garment, possibly a dress or blouse, with vertical stripes and lace details, rendered in darker gray-blue and white shades with a similar hem as the previous dress (bottom right). title: Doll Wardrobe
